home_hero_title: A Bitcoin community in the Atlantic
home_hero_text: FREE Madeira is a non-profit organisation focused on education, community building, and supporting Bitcoin adoption during the transition to a new monetary paradigm.
home_education_title: Dive deeper into the Bitcoin world
home_education_text: Explore Bitcoin education in Portuguese, designed for all knowledge levels — whether you're simply curious or eager to delve deeper. Enjoy high-quality, free, and accessible content available to everyone.
home_slide_adoption_text: With more than 160 businesses accepting Bitcoin and regular meetups, Madeira Island has become a world reference for Bitcoin.
home_slide_books_text: The Sovereign Individual is a visionary book that anticipates many of the events shaping the modern world. Now available in Portuguese.
home_slide_shop_text: Buy hardware wallets, backup solutions, books, and other Bitcoin-related products in our online shop.
home_slide_atlantis_text: Bitcoin Atlantis 2024 brought together the leading voices in Bitcoin for a three-day conference in Madeira, in the middle of the Atlantic.
home_about_title: Knowledge is the catalyst for change. By providing monetary education to all, we forge a path to economic empowerment.
home_merchants_text: Over 150 businesses already accept bitcoin on Madeira Island. Do you own a business and want to start receiving payments in bitcoin? We can assist you every step of the way.
home_merchants_map: Map of the businesses that accept bitcoin in Madeira
about_hero_text: FREE Madeira, founded in 2022, is a non-profit organisation dedicated to empowering individuals and businesses to take control of their financial future through education and Bitcoin adoption in Portugal, particularly in Madeira.
about_who_title: FREE stands for Fórum Regional para a Educação Económica — Regional Forum for Economic Education
about_who_2: We support Bitcoin adoption in Portugal, particularly in the Madeira Archipelago
about_who_3: We assist the local community, both individuals and companies, during this monetary transition
about_who_4: We position the Madeira Archipelago as a technology leader, attracting local and international investment
about_who_5: We support energy sustainability by contributing to local mining projects based on sustainable energy
about_media_kit: Media kit for all things FREE
about_donations_1: We believe that knowledge is the catalyst for change, and by providing the tools of monetary education to all, we forge a path to economic empowerment and resilience.
about_donations_2: All donations to the Project go towards education, outreach and spreading knowledge about Bitcoin in the local community.
about_donations_3: The future shines bright and orange, just like the sun over Madeira. Embracing Bitcoin will ensure that Madeirans will be able to bask in its rays for generations to come.
about_goals_1: Increasing financial literacy and knowledge of new decentralised network protocols
about_goals_2: Promoting educational workshops and courses for all levels of knowledge
about_goals_3: Creating Bitcoin-related content about the Portuguese reality
about_goals_4: Becoming the Portuguese reference in the Bitcoin world
about_energy_text: We support Bitcoin projects for energy sustainability in Portugal, focusing on education and mentorship to foster local initiatives and expand renewable energy use.
about_meetups_text: Every last Wednesday of the month FREE holds a Bitcoin Meetup, bringing the community together to share knowledge, network and enjoy presentations by select guest speakers.
about_hub_text: A Bitcoin what? Yes, a Bitcoin Business Hub. We will have a pub, an all-Bitcoin shop, a coworking space, and more. A dream in the making!
about_organisation_text: FREE Madeira is a non-profit association registered in Portugal. Our purpose is economic education: we teach monetary literacy to children and adults, publish and translate books and educational materials, carry out research in the social sciences, and organise public meetings, courses and conferences. Bitcoin is our practical focus — the tool we teach with and the one we help local businesses adopt — within that wider mission of economic education. The association is independent of any political or religious affiliation.
team_page_description: The people behind FREE Madeira, and the advisors who guide it.
partnerships_hero_text: Places that embrace Bitcoin, and the companies that support them, will be the new global leaders. Madeira is well-positioned and has the perfect environment for technology companies and Bitcoin adoption.
partnerships_cta_text: We seek investors who want to shape Madeira's future and drive global Bitcoin adoption. Join us to align your investments with your values and help shape the future of money. If you want to be part of the change, contact us. We look forward to hearing from you.
madeira_hero_text: Madeira is more than a tourist destination – spring-like climate, an active community and over 150 businesses accepting sats!
madeira_slide_island_text: An autonomous island in the Atlantic – 1,000 km from the European continent, with a spring-like climate, GMT time zone and part of one of the most Bitcoin-friendly jurisdictions in the European Union.
madeira_slide_energy_subtitle: Renewables as a foundation, Bitcoin as a tool
madeira_slide_energy_text: Madeira produces energy from its own renewable sources. FREE Madeira actively explores the connection between Bitcoin mining and surplus renewable energy.
madeira_slide_climate_text: Funchal has one of the most stable temperatures in Europe — from 19°C to 27°C throughout the year. Any month is ideal for working remotely or attending a Bitcoin meetup.
madeira_slide_adoption_subtitle: About 80% of merchants are holding onto their Sats – using Bitcoin as a store of value.
madeira_slide_adoption_text: Adoption in Madeira is not superficial. Merchants genuinely believe in what they are doing. Your business could be next.
